family_name: Bradford Anticon Roofing Blanket - Light Duty Foil

spec.description:
Bradford Anticon Roofing Blanket - Light Duty Foil is an
economical glasswool insulation blanket laminated with a Light Duty reflective
foil backing. Engineered for domestic metal roofs with closely spaced timber
battens or steel rafters (up to 600mm centres) or roofs fully supported by
safety wire mesh, it provides thermal insulation, dampens rain noise, and
controls condensation. It features a 150mm foil overlap edge to maintain vapour
seal continuity across domestic roofs and sheds.
features:
Faced with
Light Duty reflective foil laminate for cost-effective domestic applications

Designed for closely spaced framing supports (up to 600mm centres) or
mesh-supported roofs

Factory-bonded with a 150mm foil overlap edge to
facilitate vapour-tight sealing

Non-combustible glasswool insulation core
meeting AS 1530.1

Bushfire ember protection compliant from BAL 12.5 to BAL FZ
under AS 3959

Damps heavy rain noise by up to 7 dB to improve acoustic
comfort inside

Reflects radiant heat away from the roof space to enhance
energy efficiency

Bio-soluble FBS-1 glasswool approved by Sensitive Choice
for allergy sufferers

Available in 60mm, 80mm, and 100mm thicknesses (R1.3 to
R2.3)

Cost-effective solution to stop roof condensation in residential metal
roofs

install:
Confirm roof batten spacing does not exceed 600mm centres (or that safety wire
mesh is installed)

Roll out Anticon Light Duty over framing with the foil
facing down into the attic or room

Ensure a gentle sag of 25mm to 40mm
between battens to prevent compression against sheeting

Overlap adjoining
blanket runs by 150mm using the pre-extended foil edge

Seal all overlaps and
edges with Bradford 493 Reinforced Foil Tape to create a continuous vapor seal

Fix metal roof sheets over battens, taking care not to puncture or excessively
stretch the light-duty foil

Complete installation prior to rainfall to keep
the glasswool dry
selection_checklist:
Verify framing spacing is
≤ 600mm centres (if spacing is 600-900mm use MD; if > 900mm use HD)

Check
that safety mesh is installed if used over wider industrial spans

Confirm
thermal R-value requirement (R1.3, R1.8, or R2.3)

Ensure reinforced foil tape
is included for sealing the 150mm overlap

Confirm application is under metal
roof cladding
limitations:
Do not use
on framing spans exceeding 600mm without wire mesh support (foil may tear or
sag)
Glasswool must be kept completely dry during storage and installation
Foil must face downward into the building space to prevent condensation

retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford Anticon Roofing
Blanket - Light Duty Foil is a cost-effective glasswool insulation blanket faced
with a Light Duty reflective foil backing and a 150mm overlap edge. Designed for
residential metal roofs with batten centres up to 600mm or roofs supported by
continuous safety mesh, it stops condensation pooling, dampens rain noise by up
to 7 dB, and delivers thermal resistance from R1.3 to R2.3. With a
non-combustible glasswool core and BAL-FZ bushfire suitability, it provides
dependable under-roof protection for budget-conscious home and shed builds.
